$comment: A8.2 parte 2. Lo lee scripts/audio/eleven-music.mjs. `muestra` = 1 min (A+B); `minimo` = bucle de 2 min con los MISMOS bloques y estilos, solo cambian las duraciones (compases enteros). Mismo modelo y semilla.
prompt: Cool, airy and slightly uncanny theme for a 1990s point-and-click adventure game: a spotless mountain clinic with fresh alpine air and something odd behind the smiles. Recognizable flute melody, celesta and harp arpeggios, soft string pad, light electronic hand percussion, fretless bass. High-quality General MIDI light orchestral sound. 123 BPM, E minor, 4/4. Instrumental only, seamless loop.

A.descripcion: calm: harp and celesta arpeggios over a soft string pad, flute plays the melody gently, almost no percussion, clean and sterile

B.descripcion: more energy: hand percussion groove and fretless bass enter, strings swell, flute and celesta double the melody, a hint of unease, cadence back to E minor so it loops
